title: Preallocate Fusion transaction write buffer

summary: Added a transaction_write_buffer helper that reserves one write-buffer slot.

Added unit coverage proving the helper reserves capacity for the first write.
Left MVCC read timestamps, buffered write ordering, WAL generation, commit, rollback, and read-your-own-writes behavior unchanged.
